vocab.definition: separates an insoluble solid from a liquid.
separates a soluble solid from its solution.
separates a liquid from a solution by evaporating and condensing.
separates substances by how far they travel in a solvent.

misconceptions.right: Salt dissolves — use crystallisation or distillation.

misconceptions.wrong: The residue is the liquid that passes through.
misconceptions.right: The residue is the solid left in the filter paper.
The vapour is cooled and condensed back to liquid.

questions.text: Name the best method to separate sand from water. [1 mark]
In filtration, define the terms residue and filtrate. [2 marks]
Explain how distillation produces pure water from salty water. [3 marks]
Name the method used to recover copper sulfate crystals from solution. [1 mark]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: Filtration removes an ______ solid. In distillation the liquid ______ then ______ on a cold surface.

questions.text: Explain why some inks travel further up the paper than others. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Dissolved (soluble) solids pass through filter paper — only insoluble solids are trapped.
